note: Official questions mapped to SM Chapter 5 (Strategy Implementation and Evaluation). Codes: primary first. key = ICAI's published answer key for MCQs. Mapping rules. (1) **ICAI's RTPs print their own chapter headings** over the SM descriptive questions, and the pattern is exact across all eight RTPs from May 2024 to September 2026: Chapter 1 = questions 7 and 8, Chapter 2 = 9 and 10, Chapter 3 = 11 and 12, Chapter 4 = 13 and 14, **Chapter 5 = 15 and 16**. Every RTP descriptive atom here therefore carries ICAI's own label. **A correction to the note in atoms_S04.json:** there are **eight** RTP files in sources/rtp (M24, S24, J25, M25, S25, J26, M26, S26), not nine; the label pattern itself is unaffected. **A labelling artefact to know about:** in several RTP files the chapter-label line physically *follows* the question text, so RTP-S25-SQ14 and RTP-M25-SQ14 appear in the raw text under a 'Chapter 5' line that in fact belongs to the next question. Questions 15 and 16 are Chapter 5 on the pattern, which the published answers confirm in every case. (2) Past-paper and MTP descriptive questions carry no chapter label, so they are mapped by the concept of ICAI's published answer, read in full, never by the wording of the stem. (3) Part-I MCQ items are included where the tested concept is unambiguously a Chapter 5 concept. **Three stems that read like Chapter 5 were excluded** after reading the published answer: MTP-S24-S1-SQ1c (FreshDelight 'expand market presence' — answered as market development, SM Ch 4, now placed there), MTP-S25-S1-SQ1c (ZephyrFit 'leadership sold the rights' — answered as divestment, SM Ch 4, now placed there) and MTP-M24-S2-SQ1c (GreenThrift — answered as the threat of new entrants, SM Ch 2). **Two 7S atoms were moved in** from the SM Ch 3 and Ch 4 scoping lists: PYQ-M24-Q5a (BOYA Ltd, answered with the McKinsey 7S Model and its limitations) and PYQ-M25-MCQ15 (key: special alert control). **Where a question has several homes:** the strategic-uncertainty questions sit at S05.04 because the study material prints 'Strategic uncertainty and how to deal with it?' inside §5.2.2 Strategy Formulation, not in the control section; and 'Strategic planning vs Operational planning' sits at S05.04 for the same reason, even though candidates expect it under control. The 'principal aspects of strategy-execution process' answer is not in the §5.2.3 text verbatim — ICAI draws it from the wider implementation discussion — and is filed at S05.05. **Items left for the back-fill pass**, found in the same sweep but belonging to earlier chapters: RTP-M24-SMCQ1-ii, RTP-M24-SMCQ3, RTP-M24-SMCQ5, RTP-M25-SMCQ5, RTP-S24-SMCQ1-i/ii/iii/v, RTP-S24-SMCQ4, RTP-S25-SMCQ1-iii, RTP-S25-SMCQ3, RTP-S25-SMCQ4, RTP-S26-SMCQ1-iii, RTP-M26-SMCQ5, RTP-J26-SMCQ1-v, PYQ-J25-MCQ12/13/16, PYQ-J26-MCQ10/12/13/16, PYQ-M26-MCQ9/14, PYQ-S24-MCQ10/11/12 and PYQ-S25-MCQ... (the two Ch 4 ones are now placed). **A wording trap worth recording.** ICAI uses two near-identical phrasings for two different printed lists. 'Identify the strategy required for digital transformation / the most preferred practices' (Twaran, BrightWave, Nexora, the small manufacturing company) is answered with the **five best practices for managing change in small and medium-sized businesses** of 5.3.3 - begin at the top, ensure the change is necessary and desired, reduce disruption, encourage communication, recognise that change is the norm. But 'key strategies for navigating change effectively' (RTP-M24-SQ16, and the OR limb of MTP-M26-S1-SQ4b) is answered with the **five pointers** of 5.3.4 - specify aims and objectives, always communicate, be ready for resistance, implement changes gradually, offer assistance and training. The giveaway is the word 'navigating', which belongs to 5.3.4's own heading.
